The strap is tight above the wound. Too tight, probably, but the blood has stopped running down my arm.

It still hurts. More than before, only differently. The wound throbbed with my heartbeat. This is a thin, constant pain where the strap bites into me. Everything below it feels distant.

I need to remember when it went on. I wrote the time beside this entry and again on the bandage. I don't know which one will still be readable later.

For now, the floor has stopped turning red.

For now.
The warm part

The water finally ran clear.

I rinsed the vessel until there was no colour, no smell and nothing clinging to the glass. It looks new again if I hold it far enough from the light.

There is still something around the rim. Not residue. I already removed that.

Something smaller.

I keep wanting to call it clean because it looks clean. Maybe that is how this happens. You stop when your eyes are satisfied and forget that your eyes are enormous compared to the things that will kill you.

I should not put anything meant for a vein inside this yet.

The water had a skin on it. I drank it anyway. It was that or nothing.

I deserve whatever is moving around inside me now.

The wound is still hot. The skin around it hurts more than yesterday, but maybe that means it's healing? That's what healing feels like, right?

It'll be fine. I don't want to unwrap it again.
There is something...hostile...in the caves

They collapsed while I was looking at them.

Their eyes were open. Their mouth kept making little movements, but they weren't breathing. Not properly. Nothing about it looked peaceful. It looked like their body had forgotten what came next.

I put my hands over their chest and pressed.

Their ribs moved underneath me. Every compression forced a small sound out of their throat. For a moment I thought that meant they were breathing again.

It didn't. That was me moving the air.

I kept pressing anyway. There was nothing else my hands could do.

They moved on their own.

I don't know which part saved them. The medicine, the shock, the compressions, dumb luck. Probably all of it. I only know that I felt their chest rise without my hands forcing it.

I stopped pressing. Then I kept one hand there because I was afraid it would stop again the moment I let go.

They looked terrible. I probably looked worse.

They're alive.

That is enough.

This bag was different.

The improvement was not immediate, but it was real. My heart slowly stopped trying to beat its way out. I could stand without waiting for darkness to clear from my vision. Breathing finally felt connected to something again.

The saline kept enough pressure in me to stay alive.

The blood gave that pressure something useful to move.

I need both facts written down. If this happens again, panic will make them feel like the same thing.

They are not.
This is the bit where you decide.
This world can officially bite my ass.
Touch the electric coil.
Travel in a pair or a group if you can help it. you might not always be in a good condition to treat yourself.
Trigger the mine Caboose couldn't see.
Walk around with less than a quarter of your blood.
What does that big guy in town do with all the cobblestone I give him?
Who are you?
Woah! It's a reference to... You!!
Wrong blood
Yes.
You are leaving a trail.
You do not have to talk.
You have been holding that for a while.
You missed a turning about four minutes ago.
You'll Shoot Your Eye Out
always have a bandage on hand. ALWAYS.
flesh is weak. look, I dont have to worry about stubbing my toe! problem is when I do the damage just stays and doesnt heal.
i love you.
oh
stay away from Theseus_Rolaine
the flora wants to kill you here too, apparently.

lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.revolver_no_rounds: You have nothing to load it with.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.roulette_empty: There is nothing in the cylinder to gamble with.
lang_keys.doomedmatu.alert.spurt.1: Your skull splits - something is forcing its way out.
lang_keys.doomedmatu.alert.spurt.2: Agony erupts. The change tears far deeper this time.
lang_keys.doomedmatu.alert.spurt.3: Your body is coming apart. You can barely stay standing.
lang_keys.doomedmatu.alert.spurt.4: Everything fails at once. This kills you - unless you endure it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.emptybloodbag:
A stitched IV pouch with a needle.
Right-click to draw about 0.75 L of your OWN
blood into it - bank it, or transfuse a teammate
later. It won't draw if you've already bled too much.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.kyntiane_compound.war: INJECTION HAZARD: any delivered dose causes a catastrophic result.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.kyntiane_compound.yie: Rubble yield increases with delivered black-fluid volume.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.kyntiane_compound.fus: UNSTABLE FUEL: inserting it arms a 3-second fuse. It will explode before burning.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.wood_ash.info: Extinguish a normal campfire, then break it to recover 2-3 Wood Ash. An extinguished soul campfire yields 1. Lit campfires do not yield ash.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.fluid_barrel.info: Compatible graded batches can carry different purity and contamination records. Most ordinary tanks treat those records as different fluid stacks. Route repeated chemistry output through a Batch Blending Barrel to average them by volume before storage.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.title: Acquisition
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.genera: Possible random stock, not a guaranteed offer. Server rules, wallet cap, reputation and each trader's roll affect availability and price.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.experi: Possible stock from Issac's curated clinical shelf. Each visit rolls a useful spread; server rules and the wallet cap still apply.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.locked: A potential direct pool entry. A successful lockpick gives one weighted roll; server rules can remove or replace entries.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.sealed: A potential direct pool entry. The correct keypad code gives two distinct weighted entries; server rules can change the pool.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.drop_c: A potential direct pool entry. Safe timed defusal yields 3-5 distinct entries; server rules can change the pool.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.sun_fe: Break wild Sun-Ferns in warm biomes (base temperature 1.0 or higher). Each fern drops 1-2 Fern Fibre.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.frost_: Break wild Frost-Ferns in cold biomes (base temperature below 0.3). Each fern drops 1-2 Fern Fibre.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.woundw: Wild surface patches grow in temperate biomes. Break one for a leaf, or use a Foraging Knife for two.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.feverb: Wild surface patches grow in warm biomes. Break one for a flower, or use a Foraging Knife for two.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.bitter: Mature wild Bittermoss grows in cold biomes. It drops one clump; a Foraging Knife doubles it and can recover the plant.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.glowca: Sparse patches grow on dark cave floors. Break one for a clump, or use a Foraging Knife for two. Cave-flora settings apply.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.opium_: Mature patches generate in temperate biomes when opioids are enabled. Harvest for latex and seeds; Fortune can add seeds.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.cave_f: Generated cave barrels can hold %s–%s mB of this fluid at %s–%s%% purity. Some instead contain water, a 2–3-fluid crude mix, or nothing. Opioid and worldgen rules apply.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.cave_w: Generated cave barrels can hold 2,000–16,000 mB of water. Some instead contain a listed drug fluid, a 2–3-fluid crude mix, or nothing. Worldgen rules apply.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.deep_c: Mine this from deep crystal regions or clusters in roomy caves. Hazard worldgen, dimension and density settings apply; unstable crystals can detonate.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.cyst_g: Mine this in a generated underground Cyst Grove, normally between about Y -58 and -8. Cyst worldgen settings apply.
Use Shears on this delicate Cyst Grove growth to recover the plant instead of its material drop.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.cyst_f: Break Cyst Fronds or Spore Reeds without Shears. Drops 1-2 fibre; Fortune can increase the yield.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.spore_: Break a Cyst Spore Bloom without Shears. Drops 1-2 caps; Fortune can increase the yield.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.gall_b: Right-click a ripe Cyst Bush to pick 1-2 berries, or 2-3 when fully mature, without uprooting the renewable bush.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.water_: Right-click a mature bush empty-handed for a Sealed Water Pod, or with a glass bottle for 250 mL of filtered water.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.cyst_e: Shoot the lens out of a Cyst Eye, not an Ear, to drop one Torn Cyst Lens. The living lens regrows after a while.
lang_keys.jei.doomedmatu.acquisition.source.rooted: An unsearched cadaver in a Cyst Grove yields 1-2 weighted medical items. Its attire changes the weights.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.blood_bag.gamble: Donor type unknown - transfusing this is a gamble.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.blood_bag.compat: Compatibility is checked against the recipient.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.blood_bag.expired: Stored blood expired - unsafe to transfuse. Craft it alone to recover the empty bag.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.blood_bag.storage_dis: Stored-blood ageing is disabled by the server.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.blood_bag.cold_chain: Refrigeration slows ageing; it never stops it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.prosthetic_lubricant:
Right-click to grease your fitted prosthetics, restoring their condition.
Routine upkeep - prosthetics wear down as you use them.
A fully seized prosthetic needs a wrench + parts instead.
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.corebound.title: COREBOUND
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.corebound.subtitle: The transformation is complete.
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.corebound.line1: You endured what should have killed you.
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.corebound.line2: The Doom has left you - but its mark remains.
lang_keys.subtitles.doomedmatu.crawler_charge: A crawler breaks into a rush
lang_keys.subtitles.doomedmatu.spider_ambient: A spider rasps in the dark
lang_keys.subtitles.doomedmatu.spider_charge: A spider commits to a lunge
lang_keys.subtitles.doomedmatu.deep_maw_geological: The rock carries a deep pressure
lang_keys.subtitles.doomedmatu.deep_maw_grin_stret: A jaw stretches past its rest
lang_keys.subtitles.doomedmatu.deep_maw_distant_gr: A low growl travels through the cave
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.wash_station:
Right-click to scrub off all your grime.
Works anywhere - no natural water needed, handy underground.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.ventilation:
Keeps the air clean nearby. Enclosed, underground air grimes you up faster;
stay within 8 blocks of one and it won't.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.glowcap_clump: A damp, faintly glowing cave growth. Eat it for a little food and water, or grind it in a placed Pestle and Mortar into pulp for a bandage.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.woundwort_leaf:
Grind in a placed Pestle and Mortar to make Woundwort Paste.
Plant it on temperate ground; local Heaters and Coolers can maintain its band.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.feverbell_flower:
Grind in a placed Pestle and Mortar to make Feverbell Powder.
Plant it in sustained warmth; a powered Heater can maintain its band.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bittermoss_clump:
Grind in a placed Pestle and Mortar to make Bittermoss Pulp.
Plant it under cover in sustained cold; a powered Cooler can maintain its band.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.iodine:
A strong topical disinfectant, distilled from kelp.
Drag onto a limb in the health panel - a long disinfect window, a mild sting.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.aloe_gel:
Cool gel pressed from a cactus.
Drag onto a limb - soothes burns, dulls the ache, restores a little skin.
Comfort, not a cure.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cigarette:
Matu Tobacco Co. - 'A small death, held between your lips.'
Needs a lighter. A little calm now; tar in your lungs forever.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cigarette_pack:
Sixteen Matulls, still in the cellophane. Rip it open.
Matu Tobacco Co. is not liable for anything, ever.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.lighter: A cheap flip lighter. Lights a Matulls; good for staring into.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.pestle_mortar:
Right-click holding a medicinal herb to grind it
into a usable form (a short minigame).
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.woundwort:
A temperate meadow herb. Harvest the leaf, grind it,
and craft a herbal poultice - a weak early dressing.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.feverbell:
A warm-ground herb. Harvest the flower, grind it, and
craft a bitter chew that dulls pain, no opioid risk.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bittermoss:
A living cutting. Plant under cover in sustained cold; a
powered Cooler can maintain the climate. It matures slowly
and cannot be forced with bonemeal.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.feverbell_chew:
A bitter non-opioid painkiller. No breathing risk and
no overdose, but it tastes foul.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.herbal_tonic:
A murky brew of ground herbs. Settles the stomach and
gives a little energy - the last-resort drink.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.fuel_generator: Burns ordinary furnace fuel and pushes power into whatever it touches. The only thing in the mod that makes FE - every powered machine here needs one.
lang_keys.item.doomedmatu.conduit.configure: Use a wrench on the source face: Insert > Extract > Disabled.
lang_keys.item.doomedmatu.fluid_conduit.batch: Moves the exact fluid lot. Use a Batch Blending Barrel to combine mismatched lots.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.dryingcloth:
A woven rag (about 16 dry-offs).
Right-click to towel off and shed your wetness -
handy after a swim or a downpour. The cold/mood
debuff still clears the slow way; this just dries you.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bloodsac: Bloody, and it fills you. Expect to be sick, and to feel worse for having eaten it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.venomgland: A foul little morsel that puts venom straight into your system.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.geofruit: Mild produce. A little food and a little water.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.frigiantfruit: Cold fruit. Light food, and it takes some heat out of you.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.xalorissponge: Spongy and hard to keep down. Every one you eat raises the sepsis in your blood.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.foliagemeal: Processed greens, and very filling. Your stomach will complain a little.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.burger: A hot, heavy meal. You will feel more like yourself afterwards.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.pancake: Warm and sweet. It lifts you, and it sits a little heavy.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.pizzaslice: Filling, and better than most of what you find out here.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bucketofchicken: Greasy, hot, and more of it than you expected. You will feel better for a while.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.popcorn: A light snack that puts you in a better frame of mind.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.pemmican: Dense, tasty meat that keeps for ages.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.chips: Salt and grease. It lifts you, then your stomach turns on you a little.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cereal: Dry cereal. Light food, and it leaves you thirstier than you started.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.hardcandy: Hard sugar. A small lift, and a small price paid in your stomach.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.candybar: Pure sugar. It lifts you, then it turns your stomach.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.chocolatebar: Sweeter than the plain bar and worse for you. The lift is big and so is the nausea behind it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.foliage: Raw greens. You chew them because there is nothing else, and it usually costs you.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.browncap: A mushroom. What you get out of one is never the same twice.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.dryfoliage: Dried greens. Still grim, and it sometimes still makes you sick.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.nutrientbar: A compact ration bar. Solid food and nothing else about it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.internalorgans: Raw organs. They fill you, and they are revolting and toxic with it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.raw_human_flesh:
Human tissue harvested from a severed limb.
Highly filling; causes lasting psychological harm and may carry infection or prions.
Cooking reduces ordinary contamination, never prion risk.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cooked_human_flesh:
Cooked human meat. Safer than raw, never psychologically harmless.
Every portion permanently marks the character and increases the next cost.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.mushpear: A pear gone to mush. It is foul to eat and it leaves an opiate trace behind.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.waterbottle: Clean water in a bottle. It rehydrates you and takes some heat out.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.waterjug: A large jug of clean water. It rehydrates you and cools you down.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.canteen: A refillable canteen. It starts empty, so find something to put in it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.field_codex: The drop-capsule defusal manual. Carry it and press the Codex key to pull the rules up on screen anytime - even mid-defuse, while the clock keeps running. Without it, every module is a blind guess.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.field_journal: A physical record of what this character has observed and recovered.
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.field_journal.approval: Entries, scraps and sketches appear only after their authored content has been approved.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.milk: Hydrating, a light meal, and it cools you a little.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.chocolatemilk: Sweet milk. It hydrates and it cheers you, and too much of it will make you sick.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bowlofcereal: Cereal in milk. A proper meal that hydrates you as well.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.ketchup: Condiment straight out of the bottle. It feeds you, and you will regret it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.soup: A hearty, filling meal in a bowl.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sodabottle: Fizzy and sugary. Energy and caffeine now, a mild sickness after.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sodacan: Fizzy and sugary. Energy and caffeine now, a mild sickness after.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.energydrink: A hard jolt of energy, stamina and caffeine all at once. You will feel sick for it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.coffee: Hot and bitter. It quenches thirst, and the caffeine holds fatigue off a while.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.applejuice: Cold juice. It hydrates and cools you, and it lifts you a little.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.lemonade: Sweet and sharp. It hydrates and cools you, and you feel better for it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.icetea: Cold tea. It hydrates and cheers you, and it sits a little uneasy.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.alcohol:
Hydrates a little but sickens. Counts as antiseptic when crafting.
Pour 100 mL onto a wounded limb to disinfect it; the sting adds pain.
Its antiseptic window is shorter and weaker than proper wound antiseptic.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bleach:
Poison. Drinking it will nearly kill you.
A 100 mL wound pour strips contamination and a little infection,
but chemically burns skin and muscle and grants no antiseptic protection.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.splint: Stabilises a fractured limb so it can heal.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bandage: Dress a bleeding limb to slow the bleed.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.adhesivebandage:
A flimsy adhesive strip.
Wrap a wound (drag onto the limb): a token bit of skin
and barely slows the bleeding. Better than nothing.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.rippeddressing:
Improvised cloth strips.
Wrap a wound: a little skin, modest bleed control,
and eases the pain.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sterilizedbandage:
A clean, sterile wrap.
Wrap a wound: good skin repair, solid bleed control,
soothes the pain and disinfects the limb.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.analgesicgauze:
Numbing gauze.
Wrap a wound: kills the limb's pain and gives a
systemic opioid kick; light skin + bleed control.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.plasticbandage:
An occlusive seal.
Wrap a wound: strong skin repair, nearly stops the
bleed, and big pain relief.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.alginate:
The finest dressing there is.
Wrap a wound: heals skin fully, all but stops the
bleed, soothes the pain and disinfects.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.herbal_poultice:
A rough woundwort dressing.
Wrap a wound: restores some skin, halves the bleeding,
eases pain and briefly disinfects. Weaker than a bandage.
On an infected limb with no open wound it washes instead.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bittermoss_wash:
An early antiseptic made from cold-grown moss.
Wrap a wound, or wash an infected limb directly - no open
wound needed. Its skin and bleed control are weak, and its
disinfect is far shorter than real antiseptic.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.medicalsuture:
Surgical thread and needle.
Drag onto a wounded limb to stitch it shut: restores
skin and sharply cuts the bleeding (the stitching stings).
Disinfect first: filth can seed infection during closure.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.clottingmush:
A coagulant paste.
Drag onto a bleeding limb: thickens your blood
and slows the bleed.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antisepticmush:
A disinfecting paste.
Drag onto a limb: opens a disinfect window on it and
the limb above. It stings going on.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bruisekit:
A contusion dressing.
Drag onto a bruised limb to heal skin and muscle
and soothe the ache.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.icepack:
A cold compress (good for two uses).
Drag onto a limb to numb its pain and cool your
core temperature.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.boneweldingtool:
Brute-force bone repair (a few uses).
Drag onto a FRACTURED limb to weld the bone whole
at once - but it tears skin and muscle, spikes pain,
and draws blood. A splint is gentler but slow.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.painkillers:
Strong oral painkillers.
Swallow them (right-click) to dull pain across your
whole body - a heavy opioid hit.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.nocifen:
Non-opioid analgesic and fever reducer.
Swallow to blunt pain and inflammation.
Slows clotting; stacked overdose can cause gastric bleeding and organ damage.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.revivol:
Ammonia inhalant for transient unconsciousness.
Use it to rouse yourself or a downed patient.
It cannot correct blood loss, hypoxia, or circulatory collapse.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.rebreather:
Portable oxygen supply. Toggle it while carried to breathe
underwater and support low blood oxygen.
Finite charge; it cannot treat fluid or structural damage in the chest.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.activatedcharcoal:
Oral adsorbent. Swallow it to reduce nausea and bind recently
ingested opioids.
It cannot affect venom, radiation, or injected drugs; it briefly reduces gut absorption.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.improvised_charcoal_s:
A weak, unreliable emergency adsorbent made from ordinary charcoal.
It may settle mild poisoning and bind a little swallowed drug,
but it is not properly activated and can worsen nausea.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.activated_carbon_unwa:
Chemically activated carbon contaminated with corrosive residue.
Wash it with distilled water in a Filter Press before swallowing it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.heroin:
A dirty street opioid in a syringe.
Inject into a limb (drag onto it): powerful pain relief,
but it leaves you sick. Addictive.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.combatpen:
Emergency stimulant auto-injector.
Right-click for brief adrenaline and oxygen support.
Never redose while active: stacked doses cause stimulant overdose.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.bloodbaghuman:
Whole blood taken out of somebody else.
Drag onto a limb to put about 0.75 L back into your veins.
Check the donor type against your own first. Get it wrong
and the reaction comes for you hours later.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.syringe:
An empty, refillable syringe (100 mB).
Fill it with a drug fluid at a barrel or filler, then
inject it into a limb like any other syringe.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.syringe.filled:
A filled, refillable syringe.
Open the body panel and inject it into a limb.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.dialysisrig:
Wearable, battery-powered blood filter.
Suppresses toxin buildup from failed liver or kidneys while charged.
Does not repair organs; toxin buildup resumes when power ends.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.autopump:
A battery-powered blood-pressure regulator.
Wear it on your chest front: while it has charge it props
your blood pressure back up whenever it sags. It drains
its battery as it works.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.mindwipe:
A brutal mental reset.
Drink only when your mind is breaking: it seizes you, then
wipes trauma, strokes, mood and your learned wits, and
knocks you out cold. A sound mind won't take it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.neuralbooster:
A reusable brain overclock.
Speed, spring, full energy, a wired buzz, mood up, strokes
cleared. ~3 hour cooldown - force it early and the second
dose tears you apart. Wait for the cooldown.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.heatpack:
Right-click to warm your core and thaw frostbite.
The warmth spreads from the body outward, so the
fingers and toes are the last to come back. Carry these
on long cold treks.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.burngel:
A cooling burn salve.
Drag onto a burned limb to heal the burn, soothe the
searing pain, and lay down an antiseptic window so it
doesn't fester.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.woundstapler:
A spring-loaded surgical stapler (about 8 staples).
Drag onto a deep wound to close it INSTANTLY like a
suture - faster and dirtier: it stings hard and knits
the skin rougher. A clean stitch still heals best.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.suppressant: Blunts the active growth spurt for a while.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.defibrillator: Apply pads to the chest to shock a stopped heart.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.opium_syringe: Basic injectable painkiller; risk of opioid tolerance.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.morphine_syringe: Strong injectable painkiller; risk of opioid tolerance.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.epinephrine_syringe: Restarts an arrested heart; a big dose risks fibrillation.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.procoagulant_syringe: Clots internal and external bleeding; thickens blood.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.naloxone_syringe: Opioid antagonist; reverses an opiate overdose fast.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.ceftriaxone_syringe: Injectable antibiotic; immunity boost, painful jab, disinfects.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.stimulant_syringe: Adrenaline and stamina shot; too much overdoses you.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sedative_syringe:
Sedative syringe for inducing unconsciousness.
Dose cautiously while monitoring breathing, pressure and consciousness.
Removes awareness, not pain; you cannot operate on yourself while under.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antivenom_syringe: Injected antivenom; neutralises venom in your system.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antiserum_syringe: Cuts sepsis, adds blood, boosts immunity, disinfects limb.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.keratinbooster_syring: Regrows damaged nails and future claws faster, and hardens them while active.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.amiodarone_syringe: Anti-arrhythmic; stops fibrillation but harms heart muscle.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.streptokinase_syringe: Clot-buster; thins the blood, opposite of procoagulant.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.oxyline_syringe: Oxygen booster; raises SpO2, breathing and stamina.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.ringersolution_syring: Volume expander; adds blood, thins it, eases thirst.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.reliefcream_syringe: Topical; heals skin, soothes pain, disinfects the limb.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.woundglue_syringe: Topical sealant; mends skin and muscle, disinfects.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.biochem_syringe: Harsh disinfectant; scours infection but sickens and bruises.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.largebattery.source: Traders stock these, rarely. There is no recipe.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antirad: Drink to flush out radiation sickness.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.naltrexone: Eases opioid pull and tolerance; dampens mood.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sleepingpills: Forces heavy drowsiness and sends you to sleep.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.lrdserum:
A regenerative serum in a pre-filled injector.
Inject into a wounded limb (drag onto it): rebuilds muscle,
disinfects, cuts the bleeding, and floods you with adrenaline.
The chest jab also slows internal bleeding.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antidepressant: A dose lifts your mood away from despair.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.saline: IV volume expander; adds blood, thins it, eases thirst.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.blood_bag: Typed whole blood. Transfuse onto a limb to restore 0.75 L; incompatible ABO/Rh blood causes a delayed reaction.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.chest_drain:
Four sterile insertion assemblies per kit.
Drag onto the thorax to drain a hemothorax.
Disinfect first: filth can seed infection during drainage.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.aed: Apply to the chest to analyse and shock the heart.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antiseptic:
Apply to a wounded or infected limb to disinfect it.
Use before invasive care to sharply reduce infection risk.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antibiotics: Take to boost immunity and fight infection for a while.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antiviral: Clears a viral disease such as Rot Lung. Antibiotics do nothing to a virus.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.immunosuppressant:
Stops your body destroying a transplanted organ.
While it is in you, rejection is held back - and your
immune system is switched off with it. Infection,
sepsis and plague become far more dangerous.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.donor_organ:
Someone else's liver or kidney, kept cold.
Use it to replace your worst failing organ. It works -
but your body knows it does not belong, and will destroy
it unless you stay on immunosuppressants for good.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antiparasitic: Kills a parasite such as Marrow Worm, which eats your food before you do.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.braingrow: Rebuilds brain and clears stroke; toxic, overdoses if re-dosed.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.tweezers:
Hold and click an embedded limb to extract foreign material.
Disinfect first: filth can seed infection during extraction.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.wrench:
Use on a dislocated joint - opens the reset minigame, easier + no fracture risk.
Carried, it marks the stable circuit when defusing a landmine.
Hold it and select a broken prosthesis in the health panel to service it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.landmine:
Pressure mine. Leaving the plate after stepping on it detonates.
Sneak-use an unpressed mine to open the fuse panel.
A carried wrench or lockpicking kit identifies the stable circuit.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.caboose_landmine:
Concealed high-yield pressure mine.
Blends into the supporting block and uses the standard fuse panel.
Five times the standard mine's damage and terrain radius.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.lockpickingkit: Opens locked crates - and carried, it marks the stable circuit when defusing a landmine.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.thermometer: Carry it and your exact body temperature reads out on a gauge at the bottom-left of the screen.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.overclock_chip:
Jump Kit governor-removal chip. Use while carrying a standard kit.
Stronger launches and no armour drag; faster drain, heat lockouts,
and no empty-battery fall brake.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cold_pack: Right-click to pull about 4 C of core heat out of yourself. It works in any climate, and it stops at 34.5 C, which is already cold enough to be its own problem.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.plushie: Hold it to soothe a despair episode; ruined when used.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.saw: Drag onto an arm or leg to amputate it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.tourniquet: Clamp a limb to stop all bleeding below it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.opium_poppy_seeds:
Opium poppy seeds.
Plant on farmland; the mature pods give poppy latex
and fresh seeds - the head of the opioid line.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.poppy_latex:
Sticky sap bled from a mature opium poppy.
Dry it in the Drying Oven to get raw opium.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.raw_opium:
Dried poppy latex - the base of the opioid line.
Dissolve it into opium fluid (Reactor or Evaporator),
or recrystallize it with acid to start the naloxone branch.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.limestone:
Raw limestone rock.
Calcine it in the Kiln to burn it down to quicklime.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.quicklime:
Burnt lime from the Kiln.
Slake it with water in the Slaking Vat to make the base reagent.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sulfur_lump:
A lump of raw sulfur.
Roast it in the Kiln to roasted sulfur, the first step
toward the acid reagent. The fumes are acrid.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.roasted_sulfur:
Roasted sulfur, the roasting gas fixed to a solid.
Oxidise it further in the Kiln into sulfur trioxide.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sulfur_trioxide:
Sulfur trioxide from the contact process.
Dissolve it in water at the Slaking Vat for acid liquor,
then boil that down to the acid reagent. Choking fumes.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.raw_catalyst_ore:
Raw catalyst-bearing ore.
Roast it in the Kiln into catalyst clinker.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.catalyst_clinker:
Roasted catalyst clinker.
Recrystallize it with solvent to win the catalyst reagent.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.salt:
Crude salt boiled out of brine.
Recrystallize it with solvent to get refined salt.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.refined_salt:
Clean sodium chloride.
Dissolve it in sterile water in the Evaporator for saline,
or kiln it into electrolyte salts.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.reagent_solvent:
A measured flask of generic organic solvent.
Prepare it from ethanol in the Evaporator for reactions
that require a portable solvent charge.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.reagent_acid:
A generic acid reagent.
Used in purification and synthesis. Boil down acid liquor
(mineral route) or vinegar (bio route) to make it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.reagent_base:
Slaked lime - the alkali reagent.
Frees morphine from opium and feeds the fentanyl step.
Slake quicklime, or reclaim it from spent press waste.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.reagent_acetyl:
An acetylating reagent.
Turns morphine into heroin (the dirty, easy route)
and modifies cephalosporin into ceftriaxone.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.reagent_catalyst:
A rare catalyst reagent.
The hardest full syntheses - fentanyl and naloxone -
won't run without it. Refined from catalyst clinker.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.antibiotic_culture:
A cultured mould broth.
Ferment it in sterile water, or take the Reactor shortcut
with solvent - the source of the ceftriaxone line.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.electrolyte_salts:
Dry mixed electrolyte salts (Na/K/Cl).
Evaporate with Ringer's salts and water for a Ringer's IV.
Kilned from refined salt.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.mineral_supplement:
A calcium-mineral supplement.
Recrystallize with sodium lactate into Ringer's salts.
Kilned from bone meal.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sodium_lactate:
A lactate buffer salt.
Premixed with the mineral supplement into Ringer's salts -
the part that makes it Lactated Ringer's.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.ringers_salts:
The Ringer's premix - calcium minerals plus lactate buffer.
Evaporate with electrolyte salts and water for a Ringer's IV.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.wood_ash:
Ash from an extinguished campfire.
Ordinary campfires yield more than soul campfires.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.borosilicate_flask:
Lab glassware for the Reactor.
Fit it to raise the purity ceiling toward pharma grade.
It clouds over with use - re-fit a fresh one when it does.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.fentanyl_precursor:
A synthesised fentanyl precursor (the crude one-step route).
React it with catalyst in the Reactor for dirty, low-grade fentanyl.
The deep pure-grade chain yields a far cleaner product.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.fentanyl_precursor_pu:
Pharma-grade fentanyl precursor.
Combine with catalyst in a Reactor.
The reaction can detonate near flame or excessive heat.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.naloxone_precursor:
A semi-synthetic naloxone precursor (the crude one-step route).
React it with catalyst in the Reactor for dirty, low-grade naloxone.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.naloxone_precursor_pu:
Pharma-grade naloxone precursor, dried from the pure intermediate.
React it with catalyst in the Reactor for clean naloxone.
That synthesis runs violent - no open flame, no overheating,
or the vessel can detonate.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.crude_morphine:
Crude morphine, pressed out of the slurry.
Recrystallize it with acid into morphine base.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.morphine_base:
Morphine base - still wet and impure.
Dry it in the Drying Oven, then recrystallize for the solid.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.morphine_base_dry:
Dried morphine base.
Recrystallize with solvent for pure morphine solid,
or dissolve it straight for a low-grade morphine fluid.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.morphine_solid:
Pure morphine solid - the clean grade.
Dissolve in water for high-purity morphine fluid,
or acetylate it into crude heroin.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.heroin_crude:
Crude heroin, fresh off acetylation.
Dry it in the Drying Oven, then recrystallize for the pure grade.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.heroin_dry:
Dried crude heroin.
Recrystallize with solvent for pure heroin,
or dissolve it for a dirty, low-grade heroin fluid.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.heroin_pure:
Pure heroin solid.
Dissolve in water for a high-purity heroin fluid,
ready to fill a syringe.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.fentanyl_intermediate:
Crude fentanyl intermediate, calcined from acid and base.
Recrystallize it with solvent to purify it.

Purified fentanyl intermediate.
Dry it in the Drying Oven into the pharma-grade precursor.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.naloxone_intermediate:
Crude naloxone intermediate, worked from opium-derived base.
Recrystallize it with solvent to purify it.

Purified naloxone intermediate.
Dry it in the Drying Oven into the pharma-grade precursor.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.ceftriaxone_mash:
Pressed antibiotic cake from the fermented broth.
Distil-extract it with solvent in the Still for crude cephalosporin.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cephalosporin_crude:
Crude cephalosporin, extracted from the mash.
Recrystallize it with solvent up to pharma grade.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cephalosporin_pure:
Pharma-grade cephalosporin.
Modify it with the acetylating reagent in the Reactor
into injectable ceftriaxone.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.diagnostic_tablet.sca: Use on a nearby player for a one-shot WITNESS scan.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.diagnostic_tablet.cro: Use on a planted medicinal herb to inspect its local growing conditions.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.air_sampling_cassette: Hold use to expose this filter to the local air.
Collection requires 20 uninterrupted seconds; result is broad and uncertain.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.air_sample.invalid: No collection record is stored on this cassette.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.air_sample.analyse: Carry WITNESS and right-click to inspect the complete record.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.manual_air_sampler: Hand aspirator; draws a more precise local sample in four seconds.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.manual_air_sampler.ca: Requires and consumes one Passive Air-Sampling Cassette.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.atmospheric_probe: Powered peripheral; immediately measures local air and thermal conditions for WITNESS.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.atmospheric_probe.lim: Measures air only. Does not scan through walls, protect you, or identify disease.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.air_sample.needs_witn: A WITNESS tablet is required to interpret this sample.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.air_sampler.no_casset: The sampler has no blank air cassette.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.atmospheric_probe.nee: The probe cannot display without a WITNESS tablet in your inventory.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.atmospheric_probe.dep: The atmospheric probe does not have enough charge for a scan.
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.title: WITNESS // FIELD SCAN
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.subtitle: ONE-SHOT SERVER SNAPSHOT · READ ONLY
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.target_he: Select a region for the next applicable treatment on this patient. Live anatomy is rechecked by the server.
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.target_lo: TARGET · %s · %s s remaining · close, hold treatment, use on patient
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.target_re: TARGET REFUSED · move closer and rescan the patient
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.footer_ta: Click a region to target · [ESC] Close
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.monitor: No intervention indicated. Rescan if the patient's condition changes.
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.none_deta: Captured values are within WITNESS alert thresholds.
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.expired_b: Scan expired after 30 seconds. Rescan the patient.
lang_keys.screen.doomedmatu.witness_scan.footer: [BODY TARGET] selects a region · close, hold treatment, use on patient
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.matuos:
Dyeable Matu Systems handheld. Right-click to boot.
Successful Funkin at Friday runs can restore brain function when installed.
Craft with dye to recolour the casing.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.blindfold:
Wear it over your eyes to block distant sight and drain color.
Nearby shapes remain faintly legible as you feel around; this
sense bubble is visible only to you. Sight fades back after removal.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.climbingclaws:
Wearable wall-climbing claws. Push into a wall to catch and climb.
Consumes stamina; one catch per airtime.
Land to reset or crouch to release.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.climbing_claws_exhaus: Too exhausted for the claws to catch.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.climbing_claws_arms: Your arms can't haul you up.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.transplant.none: Nothing in there is failing badly enough to be worth replacing.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.excise.none: Nothing in there is worth cutting out.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.excise.too_weak: You would not survive opening yourself up right now.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.syringe_sterilized: The needle glows, then cools. Clean.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.vigil.patient: Someone sat down next to you.
lang_keys.message.doomedmatu.vigil.comforter: You stay where they can see you.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.jump_pack:
Wearable traversal rig. Re-press jump in midair to spend a boost.
Alternate wall-runs to recharge; the same wall cannot recharge twice.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.scubadivinggear:
Wear the tank on your back to breathe underwater.
It protects both your air supply and blood oxygen.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.reactor:
Powered synthesis vessel. Supply FE and adjacent heat, then load
reagents and precursor fluid. Configure fluid faces before use.
Running reactions emit fumes; volatile batches can ignite or detonate.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.drying_oven:
Dries wet solids. Needs FE and low heat (a brazier/
heater beside it). Turns poppy latex into raw opium and
dries damp morphine, heroin and precursors.
Set faces to input/output.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.kiln:
A calcining furnace. Needs FE and strong heat.
Roasts limestone -> quicklime and sulfur -> SO2 -> SO3,
and bakes catalyst ore. Choking fumes while running.
Set faces to input/output.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.slaking_vat:
A wet reaction vat (FE, no heat). Slakes quicklime +
water into base, precipitates morphine slurry, and
makes sulfuric acid from SO3 + water. Caustic fumes.
Set faces to input/output.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.fermenter:
Ferments organics in water (FE, no heat - too hot kills
the culture). Sugar/wheat/apple + water -> mash, and
grows antibiotic broth. Harmless CO2 only.
Set faces to input/output.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.still:
A distillation still. Needs FE and heat. Distils mash
-> ethanol and purifies solvents and water. Flammable
vapour - can flash to fire over a flame or when
overheating. Choking fumes. Set faces to input/output.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.filter_press:
Presses a slurry apart (FE, no heat). Splits morphine
slurry and ferment broth into a solid cake plus waste
filtrate (boil that down to reclaim base). No fumes.
Set faces to input/output.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.recrystallizer:
Purifies crude solids with a solvent reagent (FE, no
heat, no tanks). Recrystallises crude morphine, heroin
and precursors, and catalyst, to a cleaner grade.
Set faces to input/output.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.evaporator:
Heated, FE-powered concentration vessel.
Processes brine and drug solutions; borosilicate glassware raises quality.
Configure fluid faces; produces steam and flammable vapour.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.centrifuge:
Spins a mixed drug solution back into its parts. Pipe
a solution into the input; while powered it separates
one component every ~2 s (2,000 FE each) into the
output. Set faces to input/output.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.syringe_filler:
Fills empty syringes from a drug-fluid supply. Slot up
to 2 empty syringes; needs FE (10 FE per mB). Feed its
tank by pipe, bucket, or an adjacent barrel.
Set faces to input/output.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.fluid_barrel:
Homogenizes compatible fluid batches. Averages purity
and contamination by volume; ordinary tanks may reject
differing batches. Holds 16,000 mB and connects on every
side. Player-placed barrels retain their contents.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.radioactive_barrel:
A leaking waste drum. Irradiates anyone nearby once a
second, worst at point-blank (~8 block reach). Doomed
take radiation sickness; others stack poison that
lingers after they leave. Don't linger.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.battery_recharger:
A powered charging station - feed it FE from cables.
Slot spent batteries (or the auto-pump / defibrillator)
and it tops them up (256 FE/tick each). Your first
recharge here gifts you an mp3 player.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.oxygen_compressor:
A powered refill station for a spent rebreather - feed
it FE from cables. Drop a drained rebreather in the
slot and it recompresses its air tank in ~7.5 s
(a full tank costs ~7,200 FE).
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.freezer:
Powered cold storage - feed it FE from cables. While it
has power, food inside does not spoil at all; unpowered
it is only as good as a chest.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.icebox:
An insulated chest - no power needed. Stock its fuel
slot with snow or ice and food inside barely spoils
while the ice lasts. Snow melts fast; packed and blue
ice last hours.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.coil:
A live electrified coil. Step onto it and it convulses
your whole body - every limb hurt, motor shock,
blackout - and flings you off. ~30 s to re-arm.
A brutal contact hazard.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.live_wire:
Exposed, sparking wiring on the floor. Stepping on it
gives a moderate shock - burns and a jolt you can
usually ride out - but it re-zaps every ~1.5 s, so
lingering stacks burns and arrhythmia until it stops
your heart.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.crystal_irradiated:
A hot radioactive crystal. Irradiates anyone nearby
(~8 blocks). Connected crystals pool into one field -
a lone shard is mild, a big formation is a lethal hot
zone. Doomed take radiation sickness; others, poison.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.crystal_unstable:
A volatile red crystal. Touch it (or strike it) and a
short fuse lights, then it detonates - real TNT that
breaks terrain. Connected crystals blow as ONE summed
blast, so a big cluster is a cave-clearing bomb.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sound_cannon:
Line-of-sight sonic turret with a five-second windup.
Its blast is stronger underwater.
An arrow disables it temporarily.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.gun_turret:
Six-direction laser-tripwire turret.
Crossing a beam fires along that line; walls block the shot.
Re-arms after 15 seconds.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.keypad_pod:
A sealed Doomed-only pod. Right-click to open the
keypad and punch in the shown code - a slow, fiddly
entry - to spill one rare drug from its loot. Vanilla
players can't crack it.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.locked_crate:
A locked loot crate. Right-click to work the lockpick
minigame; solve it to spill the loot. A lockpicking kit
(and INT 10+) picks it open - below that you
bare-claw it and hurt your hand.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.lifepod_console:
Powered decontamination and climate station.
Use for a three-second, 5,000 FE full-body clean; sneak-use cycles heat, cold, or off.
Requires stored FE.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.brazier:
A fuel-burning brazier - the early heater, no power
needed. Its basket shows the fuel actually burning.
Any furnace fuel works; a Netherite Block becomes an
eternal core and burns forever.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.heater:
An RF heater. Feed it from a cable; while powered it
glows and warms nearby players. A full buffer runs
~4.5 min. The charge rides the block when you mine it,
so carry it charged.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cooler:
An RF cooler. Feed it from a cable; while powered it
glows and chills nearby players. A full buffer runs
~4.5 min. The charge rides the block when you mine it,
so carry it charged.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.fume_hood:
An RF ventilation hood. Feed it from a cable; while
powered it vents the acrid fumes from nearby chemistry
machines, so you can work indoors without a mask.
Makes no power of its own.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sun_fern:
A warm-climate fern. Harvest it for fern fibre - the
crafting material for insulation gear and the hot-drink
/ cold-pack. Grows where the heat is worst.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.frost_fern:
A cold-climate fern. Harvest it for fern fibre - the
crafting material for insulation gear and the hot-drink
/ cold-pack. Grows where the cold is worst.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.opium_poppy:
The opium poppy crop. Plant seeds on farmland; it grows
through 8 stages. Harvest the mature pod for poppy latex
(dry it into raw opium) plus seeds - the start of the
opioid drug chain.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.earmuffs: Thick wool over the ears. Absorbs most hearing damage until the padding gives out - but it does nothing about the pressure wave, and it muffles what you can hear coming.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.lair_receiver.use: Use and keep held to sweep for an inhabited shelter.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.lair_receiver.signal: More pulses mean closer; left/right gives a rough bearing.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.lair_receiver.scope: Loaded terrain only. Reloads from a carried battery when empty.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cyst_bush.harvest: Visible ripe clusters can be plucked without uprooting the bush.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cyst_bush.growth: Shears recover the plant; picked growth returns slowly.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cyst_filtered_water: 250 mL. Sealed and filtered by the living pod; clean, not medicinal.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sealed_water_pod.volu: 250 mL of clean water in a living membrane.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.sealed_water_pod.use: Drinkable. The membrane is discarded after use.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cyst_water_pod.harves: Mature pods can be plucked by hand or drained into bottles and canteens.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cyst_water_pod.growth: A planted bush starts empty and replenishes its three pods slowly.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cyst_lens_tissue: Wet sensory tissue. Barely food; likely to make you ill.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cyst_eye:
Cave-grown search organ. Light attracts its beam; contact alerts a deeper threat.
Projectiles blind it temporarily. Flint and steel kills it, releasing toxic smoke.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.gall_berry:
The only real food in the deep growth.
Filling, and it eats at your lungs raw - cook it first.
lang_keys.tooltip.doomedmatu.cooked_gall_berry:
